parameters.name: BandwidthType
parameters.description:
The bandwidth type of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid values: 
           
- **Sharing**: Queries shared-bandwidth instances.
  
- **Exclusive** (default): Queries dedicated-bandwidth instances.

parameters.name: GlobalAccelerationInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

parameters.name: IncludeReservationData
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include reservation data that has not taken effect. Valid values:

- **false** (default): Does not include reservation data that has not taken effect.

- **true**: Includes reservation data that has not taken effect.

parameters.name: IpAddress
parameters.description: The public IP address of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance resides. You can invoke the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ServerId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the backend service.

parameters.name: ServiceLocation
parameters.description:
The backend service region. Valid values: 

- **china-mainland**: the Chinese mainland.

- **north-america**: North America.
   
- **asia-pacific**: Asia Pacific.
   
- **europe**: Europe.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The instance status of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid values: 

- **Available**: active.

- **Inuse**: Allocated.
   
- **Associating**: Being attached.
   
- **Unassociating**: Being disassociated.
